name: Tyler Shough
note: Took over for Rattler and impressed late (17+ pts in 4 of 6 starts); premium cheap SF QB to buy now.

name: Caleb Williams
note: Market recalibrating him back toward the elite tier after a volatile rookie year; biggest jump in SF.

name: Drake Maye
note: Now above Josh Allen on some charts on youth/upside; the A.J. Brown acquisition adds a true separator.

name: Cam Ward
note: Bounce-back buzz for the 2025 No.1 pick after a rough rookie year; cheap SF hold with franchise upside.

name: Lamar Jackson
note: Flagged as undervalued in SF startups (slipping to late Rd 1) despite still being under 30 with elite output.

name: Bo Nix
note: Faller on efficiency: averaged just 6.4 Y/A despite leading the league in attempts.

name: C.J. Stroud
note: Slipping in SF on recalibration and a poor playoff; the dip may be more perception than outlook.

name: Patrick Mahomes
note: Aging-plus-offensive-decline concerns pulling his stock down relative to younger elite QBs.

name: Quinshon Judkins
note: Should open healthy with good draft capital and little competition; a strong breakout bet.

name: Omarion Hampton
note: Called the easiest 2nd-year breakout after a rookie year hurt by O-line and injuries.

name: Bhayshul Tuten
note: Etienne's departure clears the lead role, though camp points to a rotation with Rodriguez & Allen.

name: TreVeyon Henderson
note: Out-carried Stevenson down the stretch of his rookie year; ascending into a lead-back workload.

name: Jonathon Brooks
note: Up to ~RB30 as optimism builds on his ACL repair (20 months out) and Rico Dowdle being traded.

name: Jeremiyah Love
note: Premium rookie capital (No.3 overall) makes him the immediate backfield centerpiece and a pass-game weapon.

name: Jadarian Price
note: Rookie whose path opened when Charbonnet tore his ACL, but George Holani is pushing for early-down work.

name: George Holani
note: Quietly a strong bet to lead the backfield Week 1 with Charbonnet (ACL) out and the rookie unproven.

name: Bucky Irving
note: Had offseason shoulder surgery and may be limited early in camp; watch for a slow start.

name: Jordan James
note: Looked good early in camp for the RB2 job behind McCaffrey, but had a possible in-practice injury scare.

name: Tyler Allgeier
note: Value cratered after Arizona drafted Jeremiyah Love at No.3; buried on the depth chart again.

name: Kareem Hunt
note: One of the largest fallers on the July trade chart (-26) as age and a shrinking role catch up.

name: Luther Burden III
note: Consensus favorite 2nd-year leap; 3rd in YPRR as a rookie with a clear path to more targets.

name: Christian Watson
note: Contract extension and cleared target competition point to a bigger, more consistent route share.

name: Josh Downs
note: Departures ahead of him finally open the every-down role for a talented slot who's never had volume.

name: Matthew Golden
note: Disappointing rookie year but gets every chance in Year 2 with Doubs, Wicks and others subtracted.

name: Ladd McConkey
note: In the conversation to climb into the top 12 on an improved offense and a strong rookie season.

name: Skyler Bell
note: Making camp noise with a direct line to the Bills' No.3 WR role catching passes from Josh Allen.

name: Garrett Wilson
note: In his prime at 26 without a competent starting QB; risks a decline before the situation improves.

name: Carnell Tate
note: Rookie being slid behind George Pickens amid concerns about his role and QB uncertainty.

name: Brandon Aiyuk
note: Value continues to crater as injury recovery and an uncertain role weigh on his outlook.

name: George Kittle
note: Ticked up as optimism grows around his Achilles recovery with a real shot at Week 1 availability.

name: Kyle Pitts
note: Reclaiming value after a late breakout stretch (24 catches, 3 TDs over three weeks) at 25.

name: Isaiah Likely
note: Tagged an expected camp winner projected for a larger role and cheaper than his summer price.

name: Greg Dulcich
note: Biggest riser on the July chart (+77); 2nd-best TE YPRR last year, should see more opportunity.

name: Terrance Ferguson
note: Deep-league buy with an impressive per-catch average and a chance to consolidate a crowded Rams TE room.

name: Trey McBride
note: Elite but a possible sell: 2025 volume was inflated by MHJ's absence; healthy Harrison + rookie Love loom.

name: Josh Jacobs
note: Around RB24 as a near-TD-per-game producer, but age makes him more win-now hold than long-term build.
